The '''Core Faction''' was one of the two major factions of [[Senator/Legends|senators]] and [[Junior Representative/Legends|representatives]] in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] during the last years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Most were [[Human/Legends|Human]], and [[Astrography|astrographically]] most came from the [[Greater Core|Core]]. In terms of policy, they advocated increasing or at least maintaining the authority and powers of the Republic government. For at least the last few [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of his service in the Senate, [[Bail Antilles/Legends|Bail Antilles]] was their leader.

[[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum]] was their candidate for [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] in the [[Supreme Chancellor election, 40 BBY|40]] and [[Supreme Chancellor election, 36 BBY/Legends|36 BBY elections]], and Antilles was their candidate in the [[Supreme Chancellor election, 32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY election]].

Antilles' failure in the election was believed to be the reason he resigned from the Senate. His successor as faction leader was unknown, but they became [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] prime seat of power, becoming the Senate's central power during the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]], [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], and [[Imperial Senate/Legends|Imperial Senate]].

The Core Faction was opposed by the [[Rim Faction/Legends|Rim faction]].
